info.name: Quizware API
info.description: Covers every implemented endpoint through Phase 10 (match engine, scoring and standings). Run top-to-bottom, folder by folder — each request saves the ids/tokens the next one needs into collection variables. See postman/README.md for the full run order and prerequisites.

item.name: Change Password (then change back)
item.description: Sends the same password as old/new so it is safe to run repeatedly without breaking later logins. Change newPassword if you want to actually rotate it.

exec: pm.test('204 No Content or 400 (same password rejected by policy) is acceptable', () => pm.expect([204,400]).to.include(pm.response.code));

item.name: Select Program (mint program-scoped token)
item.description: Every request in folders 04 onward uses {{scopedAccessToken}}, which this sets. Re-run this any time the scoped token expires (15 min).

item.name: Clone Program
item.description: Clones the program's configuration (P6-04) without results — the clone starts Draft with no matches or scores. Does not overwrite {{programId}}.

item.name: Assign Roles (uses {{programId}} from 02 Programs > Create Program)
Import Teams — Validate (attach an .xlsx file)

formdata.description: Columns: Code, SchoolName, DisplayName, ShortName, ContactName, ContactPhone, ContactEmail — see TeamExcelParser.cs

item.description: Manual step: click the 'file' field and attach an .xlsx team-import sheet before sending. Reports valid/invalid rows without saving anything.

item.name: Upload Media (attach an image/audio/video file)

formdata.description: jpg/jpeg/png/gif/mp3/wav/mp4/webm only, magic-byte checked, 25 MB cap

item.description: Manual step: attach a real media file before sending. Uploading the same bytes twice returns the same asset with wasDeduplicated: true.

item.name: Import MCQ Questions — Validate (attach an .xlsx file)

formdata.description: Columns: QuestionText, DifficultyLevelId, Language, Option1..4, Option1..4Correct — see McqQuestionExcelParser.cs

item.description: Manual step: attach an .xlsx MCQ import sheet before sending. Import is scoped to MCQ only in this phase (D-022).

item.name: Validate Stage (before segments — expect not runnable)
Reorder Segments (locked MCQ segment keeps its index)
Reorder Stages
item.description: Sends every stage id exactly once. A partial list is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_FAILED — try removing one id to see that.

item.name: Program Readiness Validate
item.description: P7-11: program-wide check — blocked if any stage has zero segments (Final has none yet, so this should report a STAGE_HAS_NO_SEGMENTS blocker for it).

item.name: Reset Scoring Defaults
item.description: Seeds the 18 legacy point values (DefaultScoringValues) — run this before Upsert Scoring Rules to see a realistic starting set.

item.name: Upsert Scoring Rules
item.description: Id of all-zeros creates a new rule; pass back a real id from Get Scoring Rules to update Points on an existing one instead.

item.name: Preview Selection
item.description: Pool-size sanity check only (Phase 8's IQuestionSelector does the real draw). Run after approving at least one MCQ question to see canSatisfy flip to true.

item.name: Reset Tie-Break Defaults
item.description: Seeds the 3 recommended rows from 04-Database-Schema.md §TieBreakRule (League/Semi-Final/Final).

item.name: Setup — Me (capture approver user id)
item.description: The disqualify request in 11 Live Match needs the approving admin's user id.

item.name: Setup — Update Segment (MCQ → 2 questions)
item.description: Shrinks the stage's MCQ template so the match needs only a few approved questions.

item.name: Setup — Add Stage Segment (Passing)
item.description: A match segment can only be added for a format its stage has a template for.

item.description: passDirection is the numeric PassDirection enum (1 = Clockwise); the API registers no string enum converter.

exec: pm.test('MCQ and Passing from the stage templates', () => pm.expect(body.segments.map(s => s.formatCode)).to.eql(['Mcq', 'Passing']));
pm.test('back to the template segments', () => pm.expect(body.segments.map(s => s.formatCode)).to.eql(['Mcq', 'Passing']));
pm.test('locked MCQ template segment stays first', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().segments[0].id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('matchSegmentId')));

item.name: Auto-Seed Matches
item.description: Groups the stage's unplaced Registered/Active teams (D and E here) into new Draft matches.

exec: pm.test('one match for the two unplaced teams', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().matchesCreated).to.eql(1));

item.name: List Matches (Draft — capture the auto-seeded one)
Reorder Segments (live — stage disallows, expect 409)
item.description: Live reordering needs the stage's AllowSegmentReorderDuringMatch flag, which no endpoint can set yet — so this is refused. Reordering during setup (10 Matches > Reorder Segments) always works.

item.name: Pass Question (MCQ does not pass — expect 409)
item.description: Only formats with pass rules (Passing) can be passed; the Passing segment below shows the successful path.

item.name: Record Answer (Correct)
item.description: Idempotency-Key makes a retried submission return the same result instead of scoring twice.

item.name: Reverse Answer
item.description: ProgramAdmin/SuperAdmin only (D-013). Nothing has happened since, so the question reopens.

item.name: Pass Question
item.description: Passes clockwise by seat; limited by the question's MaxPassCount.

item.name: Available Topics
item.description: Empty outside a Choice segment.

item.name: Select Topic (not a Choice segment — expect 409)
item.description: Topic picks only apply in a Choice segment.

item.name: Record Answer (Correct, after pass)
item.description: PassNumber must equal the number of times the question has been passed; a correct answer after a pass is recorded as PassedCorrect (the AfterPass scoring rule).

exec: pm.test('reversed event kept in the ledger', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().events.some(e => e.isReversed)).to.eql(true));

item.name: Adjust Score
item.description: ProgramAdmin/SuperAdmin only (D-013). Updates the match and stage totals in the same transaction.

item.name: Recalculate Scores
item.description: Rebuilds the match and stage read models from the score-event ledger; the totals should not change.
